verdict.rationale: Self-hosting rendezvous or relay infrastructure is a fair question for a remote-desktop product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack does not document any on-premises, self-hosted server or relay option. The cited CLI, REST API, and custom-client configuration features concern deployment and management, not where session traffic is routed.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can self-host the rendezvous or relay infrastructure so session traffic stays on infrastructure I run
